status_as_of_cutoff: Announced / exclusive negotiations; the U.S. Army conditionally selected CyrusOne for an Enhanced Use Lease data-center project at Dugway Proving Ground on 2026-03-26, but the lease was not final and environmental review/other approvals are still required before construction.
evidence_grade: B - official Army announcement and fact sheet confirm conditional selection, site acreage, EUL structure, non-final status, and FY2029 IOC target; Utah public-notice inventory and local public FAQ corroborate proposed status and additional approval requirements; capacity is from Utah public-notice inventory and industry tracker, not an Army capacity disclosure.

actions.result_status: The Army conditionally selected CyrusOne, a portfolio company jointly held by KKR- and BlackRock-managed funds, for an approximately 1,201-acre commercial hyperscale data-center project at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah, under the Enhanced Use Lease program. The company would finance, build, operate, maintain, and decommission the facility on underutilized but non-excess Army land; the deal was not final and remained subject to negotiation, lease terms, and environmental review.
actions.access_caveat: Official Army announcement; live article returned intermittent rate limiting during 2026-08-11 refresh, but Army-hosted AMP/search cache and Army fact sheet were accessible.
actions.evidence_note: Official source for conditional selection, owner/backers, acreage, EUL structure, non-final status, USACE environmental-review role, and projected Dugway Initial Operating Capability in FY2029.

actions.result_status: Army Data Center EUL fact sheet lists CyrusOne at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah with a planned operational date in 2029 and states the selection is the first step toward a formal lease agreement; the Army retains land ownership.
